excludedHits.reason: Recorded hit must be ordinary Active damage type 1
At least one ordinary Active row required
Single captured enemy monster target required
Recorded hit caster identity must match card owner

scope: A post-baseline same-process capture of the account Hard H1-3 boss record, checked with the resource-151 ordinary Active replay adapter. Stage, account and three-star completion were matched privately in the client and decoded metadata.
limitations: Damage values appeared during live play, so the replay is not an outcome-blind holdout and adds no publication credit.
The 11 supported Active hits are chance-dependent: each matches at least one evaluated critical branch, while the actual random roll is not recovered.
The other 16 hits were excluded by the listed strict selector rules; zero mismatches do not validate those hits or whole-battle simulation.
The capture candidate has not been promoted to reviewed recorded-build evidence; a matching current catalog and same-process timing do not establish complete engine-version equivalence.
No account, replay, role-instance or card-instance identifier is published.
